description: Known Modal training failure signatures for the Hausa AI pipeline. Seeded from the 2026-07-02 fine-tuning session. Used by utils/diagnose_run.py.

signatures.diagnosis: Windows cp1252 console can't print Modal's unicode output (checkmarks, box drawing).
signatures.fix: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 before 'modal run'. The utils/run_training.ps1 launcher does this automatically.

signatures.pattern: AttributeError: '\w+Config' object has no attribute|has no attribute 'pad_token_id'
signatures.diagnosis: A 2024-era training recipe ran against today's latest libraries. Unpinned pip installs pull current transformers/torch whose APIs have drifted.
signatures.fix: Pin every ML library in the Modal image to versions contemporary with the recipe repo (check the repo's requirements.txt date).
signatures.prevention: Never install ML libraries unpinned in a training image.

signatures.diagnosis: espeak-ng has no Hausa voice; any phonemizer path assuming 'ha' support will fail.
signatures.fix: Use Piper grapheme mode (--phoneme-type text) with the injected HA_ALPHABET map in finetune_piper_hausa_modal.py.
signatures.prevention: Verify language support of any external phonemizer before building on it; keep Hausa text processing in-project.

signatures.diagnosis: A --no-deps install (or era-pinning) skipped a transitive dependency; it only surfaces when that code path runs.
signatures.fix: Add the module (era-pinned) to the image and keep the build-time import smoke-test up to date so this fails at build, not mid-run.
signatures.prevention: Image build must include: python -c 'import <every training-stack entrypoint>'.

signatures.pattern: SILENT — no error; audio/text mismatch degrades quality
signatures.diagnosis: Transcripts containing digits (dates, units, currency) don't match the spoken words; training on them corrupts alignment silently.
signatures.fix: Filter digit transcripts during dataset staging (before any text cleaning that strips digits).
signatures.prevention: utils/preflight_train.py reports digit-transcript counts; staging code must check digits BEFORE normalization.

signatures.pattern: SILENT — checkpoints named epoch=<small number> while max_epochs assumes resumed counter
signatures.diagnosis: piper_train --resume_from_single_speaker_checkpoint loads weights only and resets the epoch counter to 0. Computing max_epochs as base_epoch + extra makes the run ~8x longer than intended, guaranteeing it dies at the Modal timeout BEFORE the export/volume-commit step — losing all checkpoints (lightning writes to container-local /tmp).
signatures.fix: max_epochs = the actual number of fine-tuning epochs (counter starts at 0). Plus: background thread syncs the newest checkpoint to the volume every 15 min (latest_backup.ckpt).
signatures.prevention: Watch the first checkpoint filename in the log; epoch number must match expectations. Keep the checkpoint-sync thread in finetune_piper_hausa_modal.py.

signatures.pattern: SILENT — log output stops mid-training; app stays 'ephemeral' with 1 task but no new checkpoint syncs for >20 min
signatures.diagnosis: The local machine slept, severing the modal run client. The container freezes/zombies and bills idle without training. (Observed 2026-07-03: froze at epoch 274 of 300 at the exact moment of laptop sleep.)
signatures.fix: Stop the app (modal app stop <id> --yes), then resume from the volume backup: run_training.ps1 -ResumeCkpt /checkpoints/piper_hausa_waxal/latest_backup.ckpt (loses at most 15 min thanks to the sync thread).
signatures.prevention: run_training.ps1 launches with 'modal run --detach' so the app survives client disconnects and completes server-side.

signatures.pattern: libcublas\.so\.[0-9]+ is not found|libcudnn.*cannot be loaded
signatures.diagnosis: CTranslate2/faster-whisper needs CUDA runtime libraries that debian_slim images don't ship — the GPU is attached but the userspace libs are absent.
signatures.fix: pip install nvidia-cublas-cu12 nvidia-cudnn-cu12==9.* in the image and point LD_LIBRARY_PATH at the pip-installed nvidia/*/lib directories.
signatures.prevention: Any faster-whisper/ctranslate2 Modal image needs these two packages + LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Also: per-item try/except loops must have a circuit breaker so an environment error fails the run fast instead of 'failing successfully' through every item.

signatures.pattern: SILENT — checkpoint step count on latest_backup.ckpt is LOWER than a previously observed value from the same app run, despite the container showing continuously 'live'
signatures.diagnosis: The launcher passes a fixed --resume-ckpt path at launch time. If Modal silently reschedules/replaces the container (visible as a container-level error in the dashboard, e.g. preemption) without the local orchestration script noticing and relaunching manually, the function re-runs with its ORIGINAL static resume argument -- not the self-updating latest_backup.ckpt -- so it can resume from a point far earlier than the 15-min backup thread had actually reached. Detected 2026-07-04: v2 observed at epoch 2274/step 441000 earlier in a session, later found at epoch 2124/step 375000 on the fresh backup after an unnoticed container replacement -- a ~150-epoch, ~1.5h loss despite the backup thread 'working'.
signatures.fix: Before relying on any resume, compare the launch-time --resume-ckpt path against the current latest_backup.ckpt on the volume; use whichever has the higher embedded epoch/step. Verify progress by reading the actual checkpoint file (torch.load, check 'epoch'/'global_step') rather than trusting `modal app logs` output, which replays from container start and can appear to show stale/conflicting numbers depending on how long it's allowed to run.
signatures.prevention: finetune_piper_hausa_modal.py should read the epoch from BOTH the passed resume_ckpt and volume's latest_backup.ckpt at start and pick the newer one automatically, logging which it chose and why.

signatures.pattern: workspace billing cycle spend limit reached|SILENT — app shows Tasks: 0 with no new backups, model.onnx not re-exported, and relaunch attempts fail at App creation
signatures.diagnosis: Modal enforces the workspace's monthly spend limit mid-run: the container is killed without any in-log error, the app lingers as 'ephemeral (detached)' with 0 tasks, and new app creation is refused until the limit is raised or the cycle resets. Observed 2026-07-05: v2 died at ~epoch 2520 of 2700 when the $100 limit was hit (~11:30), diagnosed only via the relaunch attempt's error box.
signatures.fix: User action (billing — never automated): raise the workspace spend limit in Modal Settings -> Usage & Billing, or wait for the cycle reset. Then relaunch from latest_backup.ckpt; the 15-min backup thread bounds the loss.
signatures.prevention: Before long bakes, compare estimated run cost against remaining budget headroom (Usage page). Treat 'Tasks: 0 + stale backups + old model.onnx' as a kill signature and check billing before assuming timeout.

signatures.diagnosis: Launching modal from Git Bash (MSYS) auto-converts leading-slash arguments into Windows paths: '/checkpoints/...' becomes 'C:/Program Files/Git/checkpoints/...' before the CLI ever sees it. The container then receives a nonexistent path. Compounded 2026-07-05 by a second bug: a pathlib.PosixPath=WindowsPath alias inside the container broke torch.load for ALL resume candidates, so the freshest-checkpoint fallback scored everything -1 and the mangled path won the tie.
signatures.fix: Relaunch from PowerShell (no MSYS conversion), or in Git Bash set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 / MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*' for the command. Never alias pathlib classes in code that runs inside Linux containers; do it only in Windows-side reader scripts.
signatures.prevention: Launch Modal runs via utils/run_training.ps1 (PowerShell). The resume-candidate selector now refuses to train when no candidate is readable (raises instead of silently picking a broken path).

signatures.diagnosis: Batch too large for the GPU, or overlong clips exploding memory.
signatures.fix: Reduce --batch-size (16 -> 8), or filter clips by duration at staging.
signatures.prevention: Keep max clip duration filters in staging; batch 16 is known-safe on A10G for piper medium.

signatures.diagnosis: Base checkpoint path wrong, repo moved, or auth needed.
signatures.fix: Verify the exact file path via the HF API tree endpoint before launching (preflight does a HEAD request).
signatures.prevention: utils/preflight_train.py checks the checkpoint URL returns 200.

signatures.diagnosis: The Cython alignment extension wasn't compiled in the image.
signatures.fix: Run build_monotonic_align.sh (or setup.py build_ext --inplace) as an image build step.
signatures.prevention: Covered by the build-time import smoke-test.

signatures.diagnosis: piper-phonemize's compiled codepoint maps only include Ukrainian; 'ha' must be injected.
signatures.fix: Use the PREPROCESS_WRAPPER monkeypatch in finetune_piper_hausa_modal.py.
signatures.prevention: Don't call piper_train.preprocess directly for Hausa; always go through the wrapper.
